q: Can a Mexican steel or cement exporter deduct Mexico's carbon tax under CBAM?
title: Mexico carbon tax and CBAM deduction
short: Possibly, for the part actually paid on fuels behind the exported goods. Mexico's federal carbon tax applies to fossil fuels but not to natural gas, so a gas based mill has little to claim. Some states also tax emissions. The EU declarant needs proof of payment and an independent certification.
audience: Mexican steel, cement and fertiliser exporters and their EU declarants

ul: Federal carbon tax paid on fuels such as coal, petroleum coke and fuel oil used in production.
State level emission taxes paid by the installation.
Not the pilot emissions trading system, which imposed no cost.

p: Any rebate, exemption or credit against the tax, and the share of fuel that went into goods not exported to the EU.

ul: A certification of the amount attributable to the exported goods.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, coke, gas and electricity invoices and production records into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so the direct emissions behind each tonne can be traced to the documents. Emissions factors outside India are entered from the official source and labelled.

sources.label: European Commission, CBAM legislation and guidance
